items.synopsis: It is not recommended to restart chassisd using CLI command "restart chassis-control" in MNHA setup
items.description: It is not recommended to restart chassisd using CLI command "restart chassis-control" in MNHA (Multinode High Availability) setup. It will cause unexpected behaviors.

items.synopsis: Packet drops can occur when packets are received with a size equal to the default MRU
items.description: On SRX1600, SRX2300 and SRX4300 platforms, when packets are received with a size matching the default MRU (Maximum Receive Unit) value of 1522 bytes, packets are dropped, leading to an impact on traffic.

items.category: the replication daemon (repd) for Shared Memory-base
items.synopsis: RPD might crash when upgrading using no-validate.
items.description: RPD might crash when upgrading without using no-validate. Use no-validate to avoid the crash.

items.synopsis: MTU configuration is not applied from the configuration group after commit and "warning" is seen
items.description: When configuring MTU on interfaces through a configuration-group and commit the changes, those are not saved on the configuration file.

items.synopsis: Radius authentication is failing when Challenge Token is entered
items.description: On all Junos and Evo platforms, the Radius Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) failing for user login if the password and token were provided in two separate steps.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop occurs on Junos Evolved platforms when prefix is moved between dynamic prefix-lists used in firewall filter
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, when a firewall filter is configured with a dynamic prefix-list that is referenced using an apply-path statement, moving a prefix from one such prefix-list to another where both prefix-lists match the apply-path pattern results in the prefix not being programmed in the PFE. This causes traffic loss for that prefix. The issue is triggered when the configuration includes apply-path pointing to both the source and destination prefix-lists, and a prefix is deleted from one and added to the other through a commit operation.

items.synopsis: Few seconds traffic loss during previous DF coming back with EVPN-VPWS non-revertive DF preference feature enabled
items.description: With DF(designated forwarder) preference in non-revertive mode, we see previous DF which comes after failure, becomes primary for few seconds and we see few seconds traffic loss due to this.

items.synopsis: PEM mismatch alarms vanished after performing system reboot on member
items.description: PEM mismatch alarms are cleared from the master after rebooting a Virtual Chassis member containing an unsupported mixed AC/DC PSU combination.

items.synopsis: The SRX1500 drops the packet if MTU matches the MRU of the receiving device
items.description: On SRX1500 platforms, if the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) is configured to match the Maximum Receive Unit (MRU) of the receiving device, packet drops occur. This occurs because additional processing overhead increases the packet size beyond the MRU limit, causing the receiving device to drop the packets.

items.category: Libjtask for RPD tasks, scheduler, timers, memory, and slip
items.synopsis: Memory leak when deactivating/reactivating routing instances with vrf-table-label
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, a memory leak occurs when a routing instance configured with "vrf-table-label" is deactivated and then reactivated, followed by a Routing Engine (RE) switchover on dual RE systems. This issue causes a slow memory leak in the system.

items.category: JFlow bug tracker for SRX platforms
items.synopsis: Application crash is observed due to insufficient memory when a large number of JFlow entries are created
items.description: On Junos OS SRX platforms with JFlow configured with sampling interval set to 1, traffic impact is observed due to insufficient memory for the Layer 7 applications leading to application failure. The issue happens when a large number of JFlow entries are created exhausting memory potentially leading to crash.

items.synopsis: SRX4700 custom application session inactive timeout is half of the configured value
items.description: When customer config custom application inactive timeout value to control session timeout value, the actual session timeout value is half of the configured value

items.category: all logging related bugs on srx platforms
items.synopsis: Security log report messages w.r.t logical system is not generated
items.description: show security log report cli command for logical systems is not working for 24.2R2, 24.4R1-S2, if log report is disabled under root system. Work around is available for this issue.

items.synopsis: Post reboot , IPSec VPN is not coming up over MNHA active/active deployment
items.description: On all SRX platforms with the new IKE daemon (iked) enabled in an MNHA (Multinode High Availability) active active setup, with the IKE gateway is configured to use the loopback (lo0) interface with the node-local knob enabled, Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) VPN will not come up after a reboot.

items.synopsis: Tunnel sync failure on backup node post 'restart chassis-control' in MNHA Active-Active mode
items.description: On SRX platforms configured in Active-Active MNHA (Multi Note High Availability) mode, after executing restart chassis-control, SRG2 (Service Redundancy Group) came up in the 'Backup' state when the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) re-registered with iked. Due to a logic error, iked incorrectly identified SRG2 as 'Active' and proceeded to clear its IPsec tunnels. Since SRG2 was actually in 'Backup', it could not renegotiate the tunnels, resulting in tunnel loss and failure to re-establish the tunnels.

items.synopsis: Created address-sets in global address book is not visible in J-Web
items.description: On SRX platform, created address-sets in global address book may not be visible in J-Web

items.synopsis: VPN failures on SRX due to file descriptor issue
items.description: On all SRX platforms, Juniper Secure Connect (JSC) clients may fail to establish a VPN session after successful authentication if more than 20 concurrent connections per client IP are active. In a NATTed environment, the 21st connection will fail, and the customer must retry.

items.synopsis: Upgrade and Downgrade will fail from J-Web in SRX4600
items.description: On SRX4600, upgrades and downgrades will fail from J-Web with the error message: "Installation Progress failed at Receive Package File" from release 23.4 and above.

items.synopsis: Configuring sflow brings the FPC down
items.description: The sflow feature when enabled on vJunos-switch or vJunos-router can bring the FPC down (to OFFLINE) due to a crash in the vmxt process i.e. the PFE micro-kernel. The work around is to unconfigure SFLOW. The issue is fixed in multiple releases as noted in the PR.

items.synopsis: L2ald process crash is observed upon executing hidden command "show ethernet-switching debug-statistics fast-mac-update" in case the command doesn't have any output
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the l2ald process crash is observed upon executing the hidden command "show ethernet-switching debug-statistics fast-mac-update" in case the command doesn't have any output.

items.synopsis: Extremely fast interface flaps in MPC10E line-card causes cpu to hog which leads to fpc reboot.
items.description: Extremely fast interface flaps in MPC10E line-card causes cpu to hog which leads to fpc reboot.

items.synopsis: FTP default mode changed from active to passive on 24.2R2
items.description: An upgrade to libfetch caused the default FTP mode to move from active to passive. This PR corrects this as customers more than likely expect the previous active FTP functionality on their networks.

items.synopsis: High memory and CPU usage due to unintended phone-home client activation
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, high memory and CPU usage may occur if the phone-home client (PHC) is unintentionally triggered, such as when the device boots with factory default settings or when phone-home is manually configured. This can lead to system slowness, crashes, and eventual device reboots.

items.synopsis: Image validation fails during the Junos VM validation
items.description: On all Junos platforms that use pkgs/junos-vmguest/mtx/vmhost-pkg-support when loading image to 25.3+, image validation fails.

items.synopsis: Command "show pfe vxlan" is not supported on QFX5200 devices
items.description: Support added for "show pfe vxlan" CLI command on QFX 5200 devices

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: Next-hop APIs to support LDP stitching cases over BGP routes pointing to list of indirects
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms this is an enhancement for Nexthop APIs to support LDP stitching cases over BGP routes pointing to list of indirects next-hops.

items.category: RPD route tables, resolver, routing instances, static routes
items.synopsis: rt_instance memory leak on bulk configuration changes
items.description: A memory leak of approximately 17MB to 38MB in the rt_instance memory block occurs when all three components routing instances, interfaces, and protocols are deactivated and immediately activated or rolled back without a delay. This is seen in large-scale environments (e.g., 4k routing instances) with sharding and NSR enabled. A 4-minute delay between deactivation and activation or rollback prevents the issue. This is a memory leak only, with no direct service or traffic impact.

items.category: RPD route tables, resolver, routing instances, static routes
items.synopsis: The rpd crash on commit when configuring router-advertisement with DNS search label under 3 characters
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, committing a configuration under protocols router-advertisement with a dns-search-list containing a domain label shorter than 3 characters causes the rpd (Routing Protocol Daemon) process crashes and restart. This results in configuration commit failure and temporary disruption to routing protocols.

items.synopsis: Flexible-vlan-tagging option is missing under interface hierarchy on SRX3xx series
items.description: On SRX3xx series configured with flexible-vlan-tagging, after upgrading the device to Junos version 23.4R2 or higher the flexible-vlan-tagging option is missing under the interface hierarchy. This leads to a syntax error, stopping users from setting the flexible-vlan-tagging.

items.synopsis: Load balance hash-key forwarding persists when switching to Layer 3-only
items.description: On Junos SRX4600, SRX1600, SRX2300 and SRX4300 platforms, when switching load balance from L3+L4 to L3, hash-key forwarding fails; the device retains L3+L4.

items.category: SRX-1RU platfom related protocol, QoS, filtering features et
items.synopsis: On SRX4600 platforms with heavy traffic, the FPGA drops packets
items.description: On SRX4600 platforms, if a few high-priority queues handle excessive traffic, those queues can become stuck, leading to packet drops.

items.synopsis: FPC will crash in MX10003 during the Master switchover to RE1 or Master set to RE1
items.description: MX10003 FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrators) will crash if Primary RE (Routing Engine) switchover to RE1 (Routing Engine 1) or RE1 is set to Master from release 21.2 and above.

items.synopsis: The aftd process crash is seen on Junos OS platforms running MPC10, MPC11, LC4800, LC9600 line cards and in Junos OS platforms MX304, EX9200-15C
items.description: On Junos OS platforms running MPC10, MPC11, LC4800, LC9600 line cards and in Junos OS platforms MX304, EX9200-15C, aftd process crash is seen resulting in crash of FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) line card while the route module of PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) processing route churns as simultaneous actions (add/delete/read) by multiple threads on the process.

items.synopsis: Incorrect color-aware srTCM marking with yellow packet loss priority
items.description: There was a software side limitation on the highest CBS that can be configured for MPCs that have LU type lookup chips due to a hardware PR. The Hardware PR was resolved in MX240/ MX480/ MX960/ MX2008/ MX2010/ MX2020/ MX10003/ MX10008/MX10016/EX9200/EX9204/EX9208/EX9214/EX9251/EX9253/SRX5400/SRX5600/SRX5800 platforms, but the software-side limitation was not removed for the same. Due to this limitation, whenever the CBS was configured above its limit (earlier 33m), the low-level parameters used to get configured such that the packets would not have any credits available, resulting in them getting marked as RED.

items.category: Trio pfe bridging, learning, stp, oam, irb software
items.synopsis: Traffic drops after link flap on active-active ESI setup with MAC pinning enabled
items.description: On MX platforms with ukern (legacy) FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) based in trio chipset and configured in an active-active ESI (Ethernet Segment Identifier) setup, traffic will be dropped after a flap of the DF (Designated Forwarder) or BDF (Backup Designated Forwarder) LAG (Link Aggregation Group) interface member.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: cli coredump genarated when the size of buffer area (user input) increased to 1GB
items.description: Cli coredump genarated when the size of buffer area (user input) increased to 1GB.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Unexpected issues such as login failures or disabled interfaces observed following abrupt reboot during commit operation
items.description: On Junos platforms with boot-time optimization enabled, an abrupt reboot during a commit operation can cause configuration file corruption, potentially leading to issues like login failures or disabled interfaces.

items.synopsis: Native junos modules in hello-message and yang modules in /var/run/db/yangs are not same
items.description: Native junos modules in hello-message and yang modules in /var/run/db/yangs are not same. The build failure is due to a mismatch between the native Junos modules in the hello message and YANG modules in /var/run/db/yangs, causing the test to fail with a difference in lengths: 229 != 230.

items.synopsis: FPC crashing when web filtering type set to "juniper-enhanced" or "NG-juniper"
items.description: On all SRX platforms, when the web-filtering type set to "juniper-enhanced" or "NG-juniper" (NextGen-juniper), it might cause FPC (Flexible Port Concentrator) card crash and with "srxpfe" or "lcore" crash files generated.

items.category: SRX4700 interface and optics related issues
items.synopsis: SRX4700: Casino Royale: SnP:Error message observed on IPSEC config load "[Error] NH : Nexthop Entry not found for (nexthop-id:43134) , error: No such file or directory"
items.description: Error "Nexthop Entry not found for (nexthop-id:43134) " seen on SRX4700 during bootup, This has no functional impact.

items.category: Covers Application classification workflows apart from custo
items.synopsis: Custom application detection fails for L4 traffic after upgrade due to uncompiled signatures
items.description: On SRX branch series devices configured with custom applications and a signature package (sigpack) already installed, installing a new sigpack may result in the failure to recompile the custom applications, causing detection failures. During Layer 4-7 traffic processing, custom applications may be incorrectly marked as "INCONCLUSIVE," impacting application detection.

items.synopsis: "tcp_timer_keep" messages are observed in the logs during reboot trigger while PoE tests are running
items.description: During a reboot or a shutdown operation, these messages are expected due to the fact that the applications that are running in the master RE and backup RE are stopped. This indicates that the peer process (in backup RE typically) is not sending/receiving the keepalive messages. The peer process in the backup RE maybe terminated or getting spawned due to the shutdown or a boot-up activity. kernel: tcp_timer_keep: Dropping socket connection due to keepalive timer expiration, idle/intvl/cnt: 300/300/5 kernel: tcp_timer_keep:Local(0x80000001:6987) Foreign(0x80000010:56833) kernel: tcp_timer_keep: Dropping socket connection due to keepalive timer expiration, idle/intvl/cnt: 300/300/5 kernel: tcp_timer_keep:Local(0x80000001:6987) Foreign(0x80000010:55261)

items.synopsis: On EX2300, EX3400,:EX4300-48MP and EX4300 , Pause frames counters does not get incremented when pause frames are sent.
items.description: On EX2300, EX3400,:EX4300-48MP and EX4300 , Pause frames counters does not get incremented when pause frames are sent.

items.synopsis: Interface goes down after a dc-pfe (Data Centre Packet Forwarding Engine) process restart in a Virtual Chassis environment on EX4400 platform
items.description: On a EX4400 virtual chassis environment, if the dc-pfe process restart for any reasons or restarted manually, then there is a possibility of some interfaces going down.

items.synopsis: In EX4400 based POE platforms the logs related to a poe bounce event may not be seen in /var/log/messages
items.description: When a poe bounce command is issued in quick succession for multiple ports, the 'poe enabled' logs may not be printed for some of the poe ports. This is a cosmetic issue and functionality works as expected.

items.synopsis: JDI-RCT-MPC10E: Ksyncd crash on backup RE after fpc reboot
items.description: On MX series, when PS over RLT is configured where all member LTs are hosted on the same FPC and user restarts this FPC then on rare occasion, ksyncd crash can occur on backup RE. However, there is no impact on the master and only backup RE is affected. This issue is not consistent and seen only once out of ~10 or 15 fpc restart operations.

items.category: Adresses ALG issues found in JSF
items.synopsis: The SRX platform may experience a flowd process crash and generate core dump files when the ALG feature is enabled
items.description: On SRX platforms running the Junos Operating System (OS) with Application Layer Gateway (ALG) enabled, in rare scenarios, flowd process can crash and crash files are generated. While the platform eventually recovers, traffic loss will occur during this process.

items.synopsis: Type 5 VXLAN traffic drops are observed when SRX run as L3-VNI gateway and the ingress and egress traffic goes to the same Type-5 VXLAN peer
items.description: On Junos OS SRX platforms running as L3-VNI (Layer 3 - Virtual Network Identifier) gateway in EVPN-VxLAN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network - Virtual Extensible LAN) scenario, traffic drops will be observed if traffic passes through two VxLAN tunnels and traffic fails to cross the two VxLAN tunnels when the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) is processing the packet having same remote IPs for two VXLAN tunnels.

items.synopsis: Recommended command to failover from Primary to Backup node
items.description: On SRX4700 and SRX5K platform, in MNHA with SRG1 active on node0 and SRG2 active on node1, "restart chassis-control" in node0, after while, followed by "restart chassis-control on node1", both the SRGs became active on node0. However the forwarding table ARI-TS route become dead, therefore traffic to the tunnel is dropped

items.synopsis: MPC10 and MPC11 line cards experiencing unexpected reboots
items.description: Line cards such as MPC10 and MPC11 experience unexpected reboots because of CPU C-states which are enabled by default thus impacting the customer production traffic.

items.synopsis: MPC10E: Support of G.8275.1 PTP Hybrid mode with speed 400G
items.description: MPC10E-400G speed PTP performance is not compliant with class-B for ITU-T-G.8273.2.

items.synopsis: JUNOS_REG: QFX51200-48YM: Fan status output was not same after/before device vc-switch over.
items.description: In a QFX51200-48YM-8C VC setup, after a a mastership switch over fan tray of linecard may not be displayed in show chassis hardware and show chassis environment. There is no functional impact

items.synopsis: Mismatch between CLI error message and netconf error message - leads to unclear error message displayed to customers
items.description: There is no traffic impact due to this PR. The config commit error message that is displayed when netconf is used is different from the one that we get when CLI commands are used. This is not specific to SSL Proxy and same issue applies to some other config commands as well.

items.category: Configuration mgmt, ffp, load-action, commit processing
items.synopsis: Netconf RPC commit fails due to commit warning received for unprotect operation, CLI commit completes with warning
items.description: In Netconf private edit configuration session, commit RPC fails when unprotect operation is performed.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: XML namespace string in rpc-reply tag for system-uptime-information was changed to represent the full version name.
items.description: XML namespace string in rpc-reply tag for system-uptime-information was changed to represent the full version name.

items.category: Issues related to YANG Data Models
items.synopsis: Few yang package are occuring multiple place On Box
items.description: Few yang package are occuring multiple place On Box
